summary: No installer-side threat identified in tailwind-hide-scrollbar@2.2.0
details: tailwind-hide-scrollbar@2.2.0 is a small Tailwind CSS plugin package. No install-time lifecycle scripts, remote fetches, credential reads, exfiltration endpoints, or obfuscated payloads were observed in the shipped files. No indicators of embedded malicious code, backdoor, silent-relay, or dependency-chain dropper behavior are present.
